This template collects every display and overlay component from the source examples. Keep it open while theming to see how token changes affect the kit in both color schemes.

<TemplateFrame src="/zazz/examples/components.html" title="Components template" />

## Included patterns

- Each section places a component's `data-variant` and `data-size` values side by side, making token changes easy to compare.
- The tooltip, menu, and dialog use native popover and invoker command attributes. The page has no JavaScript for positioning or open and close behavior.
- The cards section combines subgrid rows, `bg-card`, a badge, and a footer. The [component docs](/docs/components/card) explain this composition step by step.

See the [components section](/docs/components/button) for individual component guides and copyable examples.
